faq.a: Adeel Sattar is a .NET Developer and Full-Stack Engineer who builds enterprise backends and modern Angular frontends.
He works with .NET 10, ASP.NET Core, Angular 20, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and common database and DevOps tooling like PostgreSQL and Docker.
Custom software development, web applications & APIs, AI integrations, WordPress solutions, and growth systems.
